description: Retrieve relevant memories from the project memory store. Returns memories ranked by relevance, strength, and recency within the token budget. Use at session start or when you need context about a topic. Pass include_continuity=true to also surface the active task snapshot, latest matching session handoff, and recent session events as a "## Continuity" appendix.

budget.description: Max tokens to return (default: config.defaultBudget, 4000; max 100000)

fresh_tail_count.description: When > 0, surface the last N kind=raw rows tagged isFreshTail=true regardless of query match. Useful for "what did I just see" continuity. Capped at 200.

fresh_tail_session_id.description: Restrict the fresh-tail window to a specific session. Without this, fresh-tail is tenant-wide.

include_continuity.description: Append continuity context (active snapshot + handoff + last 5 session events) below the memory results. Useful at session boot.

query.description: What to search for in memory (natural language)

scope.description: Restrict results and continuity to memories/rows matching this scope exactly. When omitted, default-deny applies to ANY <source>:private:* (slack, github, ...) and unknown-legacy rows.

scorer_window.description: How many of the top-ranked memories the fresh-tail and summarize-overflow appendix is worked out against. The main list ranks the whole tenant store, so scorer_window does not narrow it. Default 200. Rejected as RecallContractError code=invalid_scorer_window if 0/negative/non-finite/non-numeric.

session_id.description: Optional session id. When set AND (tenant, session) has active goals, applies the dlPFC goal-stack boost to the ranked memories before formatting. Mirrors fresh_tail_session_id shape (256-char cap).

summarize_overflow.description: When true (default), entries that overflow the limit and share a level-2 parent summary cause that summary to be appended in their place. Set false for strict-limit behaviour.

name: hippo_recall
